test_title: PYST 6: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Gurman drove 28 km towards the West, took a left turn and drove 22 km. She then took a right turn and drove 18 km. She again took a right turn and drove 22 km. How far is she from starting point in a straight line?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Gurman drove 28 km towards the West.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62cc81ff498fb79324189ca3a90fd4df123f2f107fb639290b8cc11b9b998ff5.png] 

2) Then she took a left turn and drove 22 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4075a654d35613c266e76b2806d3d1b20309053a13a0671ef2477196126bc73.png] 

3) She then took a right turn and drove 18 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4809a60eaec733dacdd08045a4af0b3dbc204f7dc5fe4caccf0d4b8f459a4524.png] 

4) She again took a right turn and drove 22 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/153d703c8ce9666a58f2d55f14d2df865ef7285767853eacd0d7730acbc6ff49.png] 

The total distance from her starting point = (28 + 18) = 46 km.

Hence, the correct answer is **"46 km"**.
